# Qube Catalyst (Pearl Oguchi)

> Pearl Oguchi helps tech founders work out why nobody is using their app, and fix it. She has 22 years in software, starting as a QA tester, including 9 years at Meta working on product quality. She works with early-stage and newly funded founders, and with accelerators and venture programmes that support them. Based in England, working with founders everywhere.

## Main resource
- [Why is no one using your app?](https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/why-is-no-one-using-your-app.html): Pearl Oguchi's guide for founders whose app isn't getting users: how to tell a distribution problem from a product problem, and what to fix first. Six chapters, added weekly.
  - Chapter 1, Ready to share: Is my app ready for real users? How to test it before you share it, even with no users yet: https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/why-is-no-one-using-your-app/ready-to-share.html

## Product Lab articles
- [Preventative Retention: Fixing Software Churn Before You Launch](https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/fix-churn.html): Stop chasing 1,000 users if your software is missing its bottom. Learn how to audit your onboarding flow, eliminate cognitive friction, and fix retention before launch.
- [Kill the Founder: Eliminating High-Touch SaaS Retention Fractures](https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/kill-the-founder.html): Why high-touch management hides systemic scaling flaws. Learn to configure your application to onboard and retain users entirely on its own engineering merits.
- [What Listening to Users Actually Looks Like: Behavioral Analytics Brief](https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/listening-to-users.html): Navigating the critical variance between stated user feedback and actual product behavioral metrics. Build research loops that identify genuine product need.
- [Vibe Code, But Make It Make Sense](https://qubecatalyst.com/lab/vibe-coding-reality-check.html): A practical one-page reality check for founders who are vibe coding an app and want to clarify the user journey, feature logic, and next step.
- [What’s Happening](https://qubecatalyst.com/events.html): What’s happening at Qube Catalyst: product insights, founder-facing events, demos, ecosystem activity, and updates from Pearl Oguchi on technology, product quality, and responsible innovation.

## What she helps with
- Why no one is using an app: whether it's a distribution problem (not enough of the right people know it exists) or a product problem (people arrive and leave)
- Users who sign up but don't come back
- Homepage and messaging that doesn't explain the product
- Onboarding that asks for too much before users get value
- Product-market fit, retention and first users for early-stage apps
- Fractional product leadership for scaling startups where the founder has become the bottleneck
